name: Master Desert Set
description:
Master Desert Set is an armor Set in Outward.

Although being an upgraded version of the Desert Set and Elite Desert set, each piece actually has less Hot Weather Defense than their respective Desert set pieces.

The Master Desert Veil and Master Desert Tunic are Legacy Chest upgrades of their respective Elite Desert set pieces. However, since the Elite Desert set does not include boots, the boots are instead the Legacy Chest upgrade of the Desert Boots.

name: Master Trader Set
description:
Master Trader Set is a Set in Outward.

The Master Trader Set offers very low defensive bonuses, but makes up for those with a stamina usage reduction bonus, movement speed bonuses and a pouch max weight increase of 12.

name: Merton's Bones
description:
Merton's Bones is a cosmetic item set obtained from the rooftops of Cierzo. The items are well hidden, and players will need to find a way to exploit the ramps and ledges which lead up to the rooftops.

The Skull is found above Helen Turnbull's house, and the Ribcage and Shinbones are found above Loud-Hammer.

Merton's Firepoker can be found at Tree Husk, after a lever in Dolmen Crypt has been pulled.

name: Runic Set
description:
Runic Set is a Set in Outward. All the set pieces are regularly sold by Quikiza the blacksmith in Berg.

Among all the armor pieces that provide a mana cost reduction, the Runic Set pieces offer the highest physical damage reduction and along with the Antique Plate Sallet are the only ones that provide protection. Therefore, this set is indicated for melee combat mages, especially when fighting enemies which inflict physical damage. Being a heavy armor set, it slows down the wearer and it taxes the stamina.

name: White Priest Set
description:
White Priest Set is one of the Armor Sets in Outward with multiple head piece combinations. It protects the wearer with massive elemental resistances against fire, frost and decay, at the price of a moderate physical resistance and mediocre impact resistance.

The White Priest Hood offers a cheaper variant (100 silvers discount), the regular set uses the White Priest Mitre. The stats shown in the infobox are with the Mitre, not the Hood.

All the set pieces are regularly sold by Laine the Alchemist in Monsoon.
